text:
You're not balding. You're choosing to look weak.

Two options. Zero middle ground.

1. Keep it. Clean, styled, fresh cut every 10 days. Full maintenance. Own it.

2. Shave it to the skin with a razor. Build muscle. Grow a beard. Fix your posture. Add one bold accessory.

The third option is patchy and unkempt. That is the worst of all three.

Every man who looks dangerous made a decision.

Patchy men are still deciding.

Pick today.
caption:
Most men never make a real decision about how they look. Self improvement and mindset mean nothing if you won't even choose how to show up.
Send this to a man who needs it today.
